Players can send blessings or curses into each other's levels as a part of the game's parallel multiplayer experience. Players can change their gameplay options to limit interaction to their own friends, making the game more co-op friendly.

x360-assassin-s-creed-iv-black-flag.exp: Team up with up to 3 friends to track down and assassinate your targets as quickly and quietly as possible in order to score points, add time to the clock, and advance to the next sequence

x360-assault-heroes.exp: Co-op play allows players to team up to take down the enemy. There are even special attacks which encourage team play. In Assault Heroes, take on the role of the only surviving member of an elite special forces unit searching for a secret underground lab. Play the mission alone or fight side-by-side with a friend in the two-player cooperative mode. Hop into a heavily armed 4x4, maneuverable speed boat, or trusty military-issue footwear, blasting your way through enemy-infested territory while being assaulted by waves of formidable enemies with unrelenting attacks.

x360-attack-of-the-movies-3d.exp: Four players wear 3D glasses and shoot pretty much anything that moves.

x360-avatar-the-last-airbender-the-burni.exp: Team up with a friend and play as Aang, Katara, Sokka, and, for the first time, Toph or Jet, as you battle enemies and solve puzzles in your adventures.

x360-awesomenauts.exp: Three players can team up in local, online, or mixed co-op and play against bots. Push down towers to destroy the core and win the game.

x360-babel-rising.exp: Babel Risings co-op mode is a splitscreen control pad only survival mode. You and a friend must survive as long as possible by using your God like powers to crush humans in this Real Time Tower Defence game.

x360-band-hero.exp: Up to four players can sing, strum, and smack their way to stardom.

x360-band-of-bugs.exp: Play co-op scenarios with a friend.

x360-bandfuse-rock-legends.exp: Form bands and play along with your favorite songs, or create original music in real-time with up to 4 players.

x360-bangai-o-hd-missile-fury.exp: Players encounter insane gameplay and face an incredible onslaught of enemies in single player or in co-op mode with their friends.

x360-battleblock-theater.exp: BattleBlock Theater features a co-op campaign for two online or local players. Four local players can play nine different Arena modes against bots.

x360-battlefield-bad-company-2.exp: NOTE: Co-Op is only available after purchasing the Onslaught DLC pack. Onslaught is a cooperative mode for four players on Valparaiso, Atacama Desert, Isla Inocentes and Nelson Bay. Your team will need to complete objectives on each of the maps, with some maps focused on vehicle combat and others more on infantry. Plenty of AI soldiers will stand in your way, and it appears as if you'll be ranked somehow as the content promises dedicated leaderboards.

x360-battlestations-pacific.exp: Up to four players can join up and fight in the skirmish modes against the AI.

x360-beautiful-katamari.exp: The King of all Cosmos and the Prince are back, and now in full, next-generation glory! The classic Katamari experience returns with all-new features set to make this the best roll-up-everything-you-see game ever. Increased processing power means seamless Katamari growth. A brand-new soundtrack full of catchy tunes backs you up throughout the game. Check out the rest of the new levels, and pick your character from a list of over 50, including the Prince and his cousins, old and new. Race with a friend on the same TV, make sure your communication is at its peak as you share one Katamari in Co-Op, or, for the first time, take on other players from around the world online!

x360-binary-domain.exp: Four players can team up online in Invasion mode. They must work together to defeat progressively harder waves of robot attackers.

x360-bionic-commando-rearmed.exp: Two players can work their way through the campaign together. The 2nd player is just a color-swapped version of the main character. The game features dynamic split-screen. As long as both characters are close enough it is a shared screen.

x360-bionic-commando-rearmed-2.exp: Team up with a partner for some couch co-op swinging, shooting, and jumping

x360-birds-of-steel.exp: Team up with friends in co-op missions.

x360-blacklight-tango-down.exp: Team up with friends in a co-op mode that includes character progression and unlocks.

x360-blades-of-time.exp: The game offers a mode called "Outbreak" which is similar to a MOBA (Multiplayer Online Battle Arena) in which two players try to destroy the AIs turrets and enemy base.

x360-blazing-angels-squadrons-of-wwii.exp: All multiplayer modes can be played against the AI. In addition there are historical missions available to tackle with friends.

x360-blood-knights.exp: You can play Blood Knights either solo and switch between both characters to use their individual skills, or invite a friend to join your game and fight alongside them.

x360-boogie-bunnies.exp: Help the Boogie Bunnies achieve their dream of superstardom as they shimmy shake their way through exotic, colorful destinations all the way to Hollywood. Only you can ensure they make it. In this revolutionary match-3 puzzle game, Boogie Bunnies lets you match up these wacky disco fur balls from three different sides�left, right, and from the bottom. Score chain combinations and watch them get their groove on. Let's get the party started!

x360-borderlands-2.exp: Players work together using four different classes of characters to complete quests, gather loot, and trade items. All three systems support online co-op. Local co-op is available on the console versions.

x360-borderlands-the-pre-sequel.exp: Players work together using four different classes of characters to complete quests, gather loot, and trade items. All three systems support online co-op. Local co-op is available on the console versions.

x360-brink.exp: Brink promises to blend offline and online co-op into a seamless experience with persistent characters that can join games at anytime.

x360-bubble-bobble-neo.exp: Complete co-op specific puzzles with friends.

x360-bullet-soul.exp: Two players can take on the enemy armada together in the main arcade mode. Each player must select a different ship.

x360-bullet-soul-infinite-burst.exp: Two players can play together in each of the four different game modes

x360-bulletstorm.exp: Anarchy is a 4 player co-op mode of Bullestorm that has players working together to stay alive and score big points at the same time.Anarchy will have players working together to not only survive, but to achieve a certain score to progress through the waves of enemies. Not only will players have their own skill shots at their disposal, but cooperative skill shots as well.

x360-bully-scholarship-edition.exp: The Co-Op mode of Bully: Scholarship Edition allows you to play the classroom mini games with a partner. It does not allow you to play through the story.

x360-burnout-paradise.exp: Race with up to 8 players to complete various cooperative challenges. For instance all the players must work together to achieve a certain amount of jump distance. Advanced challenges have players performing simultaneous stunts.

x360-cabela-s-dangerous-hunts-2013.exp: Take on waves of bloodthirsty beasts in the Maneater mode that pits you and a partner in a split screen survival mode.

x360-cabela-s-survival-shadows-of-katmai.exp: Players can work together to complete the shooting gallery game modes.

x360-caladrius.exp: All modes can be played together with a second player.

x360-call-of-duty-advanced-warfare.exp: In Exo Survival, one to four players embark on a horde mode with objectives sprinkled in.

x360-call-of-duty-ghosts.exp: There are a variety of co-op modes available. The most cooperative is a 4 player co-op mode called Extinction where players build defenses and take down aliens. Squad modes allow for players to team up versus AI opponents. Squad modes include: Wargames - 6 player co-op against bots on multiplayer maps Squad Assault - 6 player co-op against AI bots created by friends squads Safeguard - 4 player co-op survival mode

x360-call-of-duty-modern-warfare-2.exp: Play through specific co-op scenarios in the Special Forces mode. It's currently being described as similar style missions to the "Mile High" mission at the end of Call of Duty 4. Each scenario has different styles of play like survival modes, timed modes, and unique objectives. For instance one player may use a laser designator to target specific areas for another player who is in control of the DC-130 aircraft.

x360-call-of-duty-modern-warfare-3.exp: Play with a friend locally or online in 16 Spec-Ops missions, scenarios designed to play in co-op. Also available are survival style missions against infinite waves of enemies. Co-Op gets its own perks and unlocks as well as leaderboards.

x360-call-of-duty-world-at-war.exp: The co-op campaign allows players to rank up and unlock perks in competitive multiplayer by completing challenges and earning experience points, adding continuous re-playability and team-based gameplay. After completing single player you unlock a 4 player survival mode with Nazi zombies. Players are required to hold a structure by buying weapons, ammo, and fortifying the structure. This mode is playable in 2 player split screen as well as online. Note: You are unable to save progress while playing in Split Screen co-op.

x360-call-of-juarez-the-cartel.exp: 3-Player Co-Op: Play the 15-mission campaign mode solo or with up to 2 friends.

x360-capsized.exp: Play through co-op specific levels with a friend.

x360-cars-2.exp: Up to four players can play locally throughout the campaign and Free Play modes.

x360-castle-crashers.exp: The game allows 4 players each choosing a character to defeat countless hordes of enemies and save the princess.

x360-castlestorm.exp: Two players team up in a survival mode or last stand mode. In survival one of you mans the ballista, whilst the other acts as a hero. Last stand mode sees both of you in acting the hero against endless waves of enemies.

x360-catherine.exp: Two player couch co-op is supported in the Babel mode, which is unlocked once the single-player story mode is completed. Players work together to reach the top of the tower while avoiding hazards along the way.

x360-charlie-murder.exp: Four players choose from five characters they can customize, upgrade, and compete in this beat em up.

x360-child-of-light.exp: Child of Light is a side-scroller and RPG all rolled into one. Up to two players control Aurora and Igniculus. Aurora uses her various platforming skills, including using flight, to explore the world and also has various combat skills to dispatch enemies with. The second player controls her following ball of light, Igniculus, who supports her outside of combat by revealing hidden areas and interacting with objects, as well as inside combat with healing powers and stun effects.

x360-clash-of-the-titans.exp: Team up with a friend to complete quests.

x360-cloning-clyde.exp: Have you ever been cloned? Ever wonder what it would be like to be a chicken? A monkey? A frog? Well, wonder no more when you play Cloning Clyde, the zany side-scrolling platformer game on Xbox Live Arcade, new from NinjaBee. Cloning Clyde is a 3-D side-scrolling adventure, featuring (of course!) multiplayer gameplay. Play split screen on a single console, or mutate online with your friends across the world via Xbox Live� Arcade.

x360-cloudberry-kingdom.exp: Up to four player gaming with local multi-player and Co-Op modes, including bungee mode, where all players are tethered together and must collaborate to clear a level.

x360-cloudy-with-a-chance-of-meatballs.exp: A second player can join/leave at anytime to play the role of Flint's companion, the monkey

x360-commanders-attack-of-the-genos.exp: The co-op mode in this allows players to team up against the AI in skirmish style missions. The game will feature a single player campaign of 15 missions, as well as online and same machine multiplayer play of up to 4 players, with skirmishes and co-op play. Commanders: Attack of the Genos is a turn-based strategy Xbox Live Arcade game developed by Southend Interactive for the Xbox 360, featuring strategic troop placement and head-to-head warfare, using such weaponry as missile launchers, bombers and infantry. The game will feature high-definition graphics featuring a 1930�s art deco style look and feel, inspired by The War of the Worlds.

x360-contra.exp: A second player can join in and help fight Red Falcon.

x360-crackdown-2.exp: The campaign is playable with 4 players online. Players can revive fallen teammates, collect co-op only orbs, and help complete the host's city while bringing their skill progression back into their own single player game.

x360-crash-of-the-titans.exp: At any point in the game, a second player can join in the fun and play as Carbon-Crash to help unleash total chaos! In a totally innovative twist to co-op action gaming, Crash can even hijack Carbon-Crash (or vice versa) for some hysterical Crash "jacked"-Crash mayhem.

x360-crimson-alliance.exp: An action RPG that features 4 player co-op, both locally and/or online.

x360-damnation.exp: Play through the game with a partner in this wild west meets Gears of War style game.

x360-dance-central-2.exp: Dance Central 2 now offers full two player tracking where you can team up on scoring to complete songs. Each person can play on their own difficulty and have their own routine.

x360-dance-paradise.exp: In "Synchro" mode two players need to dance the same choreography.

x360-darwinia-plus.exp: Darwinia+ Offers four players a chance to face off against the AI in specific missions.

x360-de-blob-2.exp: Co-op is somewhat lacking where player two is limited to picking up items and blasting enemies, but little else. Player two is reduced to a reticle that cannot help de Blob paint the world or even earn achievements/trophies in the game. This is a perfect type of co-op for something like a gaming parent and a very young child - otherwise it�s better left single-player.

x360-dead-island.exp: Team up online with four players to survive a zombie infested island. �Players can trade items and weapons, drive each other around, revive fallen teammates, and kick the crap out of zombies.

x360-dead-island-riptide.exp: The co-op experience is identical to the original Dead Island. Four players can drop in and out of each others games and missions. Enemies and loot scale to the individual players.

x360-dead-rising-2.exp: Each player takes the role of Chuck, the game's main character - but they can completely customize the look of their character as they take on hordes of zombies together.

x360-dead-rising-2-case-west.exp: Two players can take the roles of Chuck Greene and Frank West over Xbox LIVE

x360-dead-rising-2-off-the-record.exp: Two players can play the entire game cooperatively online in both story mode and sandbox mode. �Both characters will earn XP and cash. �Story progress and weapons stay in the host�s game.

x360-deadfall-adventures.exp: Deadfall Adventures features a co-op survival mode.

x360-deathsmiles.exp: Two players can work together in this shoot-em-up, but neither player will earn Achievements in co-op.

x360-deathspank.exp: DeathSpank will feature local co-op gameplay, so friends can team up to play both DeathSpank and his trusty sidekick, Sparkles the Wizard.Player 2 is more of a "helper" than a full featured co-op partner.

x360-def-jam-rapstar.exp: Rap with another friend through any of the games songs. �Certain songs are set up for a duet while others allow you to alternate verses.

x360-defenders-of-ardania.exp: Team up against the AI with up to three other friends.

x360-defiance.exp: The servers for this game were closed down in April 2020. Defiance was an MMO, so you could meet and interact with a massive amount of other people. Dozens of players could participate in Arkfall events, but story mission groups and co-op instances were limited to four players.

x360-destiny.exp: Players can join fireteams of 3 players for co-op play. Co-Op can exist in larger groups via dynamic world events.

x360-destroy-all-humans-path-of-the-furo.exp: There's one co-op challenge available. All others are versus.

x360-diablo-iii.exp: Choose between five classes (Monk, Witch Doctor, Wizard, Barbarian, and Demon Hunter) and play with four friends locally or online. Players can trade items and complete quests. Difficulty scales based on number of players.

x360-diabolical-pitch.exp: Two players team up locally to battle monsters via baseball pitches and special moves.

x360-diner-dash.exp: Team up locally or online to play through the game's "endless" mode with a friend. You'll work together waiting tables and trying to keep customers happy.

x360-disney-infinity.exp: Two player local co-op via split screen and four players can play online co-op. Co-Op can be played in mini-games, the ToyBox, and Playsets. Playsets are limited to characters of the same universe.

x360-disney-sing-it-high-school-musical-.exp: Sing all songs together with a friend in duet mode.

x360-disney-universe.exp: Team up to take on any level in the game. Co-op specific puzzles enhance the fun, but friendly fire cannot be turned off.

x360-dj-hero-2.exp: Players can drop in and out of party play using either a turn table or microphone. �Up to two turntables can be played at the same time.

x360-do-don-pachi-dai-fukkatsu-black-lab.exp: Two players team up to stop NEXY.

x360-dodonpachi-saidaioujou.exp: 2-player local co-opsupport is available for most modes. As with most CAVE games, Achievements can't be earned in multiplayer.

x360-dogfight-1942.exp: SURVIVAL MODE - Fly with your wingman battling countless waves of enemies; CAMPAIGN CO-OP MODE - Fly with your wingman through various Co-op campaign missions fighting the Axis Alliance;

x360-doom.exp: Experience all the classic DOOM levels, monsters, and weapons. Play the entire single-player game solo or in co-op mode via split screen or over Xbox Live.

x360-double-dragon.exp: Each player can control one of the brothers.

x360-double-dragon-ii-wander-of-the-drag.exp: Players team up as Billy or Jimmy Lee in their quest for vengeance following the death of Billy's girlfriend Marian.

x360-double-dragon-neon.exp: Two players can take on the roll of the Lee brothers, battling enemies with friendly fire enabled or disabled. Three high-five moves require cooperation to perform, allowing players to share life, buff each other, or steal life. Downed players can be revived by rewinding a floating tape (rapidly pressing a button) that floats over their bodies. A player who runs out of lives can also steal a life from the remaining player.

x360-double-fine-happy-action-theater.exp: Happy Action Theater's minigames can track up to six players at once. Players work together to pop balloons, shoot down enemies, and more. Some minigames work better with less people, as standing in front of each other can cause players to disappear. The game is definitely intended to be played with others though.

x360-dragon-age-inquisition.exp: Dragon Age multiplayer is an action-packed dungeon-crawling four-player co-op experience that lets gamers play with their friends for the first time in the Dragon Age franchise.

x360-dragon-ball-xenoverse.exp: Three players battle online versus AI opponents.

x360-dragon-ball-z-battle-of-z.exp: Four players per team can use various fighters from the Dragonball Z universe in head to head combat.

x360-driver-san-francisco.exp: Up to two players can play three co-op modes in splitscreen... or an inventive party of eight online players can have fun in Free Roam.

x360-duke-nukem-3d.exp: Take down those bastard aliens with 8 people in the online co-op mode.

x360-dungeon-defenders.exp: Team up as one of four characters each with their own unique abilities and traps to conquer dungeons in this tower defense action/RPG hybrid.

x360-dungeon-fighter-live-fall-of-hendon.exp: Team up to clear dungeons with any combination of four online or offline players. Oddly, items can only be traded between players online, while parties can only stay together between dungeons offline.

x360-dungeon-siege-iii.exp: The co-op mode allows up to three friends to join your game as helpers. Players can choose character classes, collect loot, and assist using tactics. Sadly XP and Loot does NOT carry back to your single player game if you play as a guest.

x360-dynasty-warriors-6-empires.exp: Players can play the action stages in split screen co-op. To Play Co-Op: In Ruler mode, you just have to have at least (not including your self) one other officer. Then at the Deploy Officers screen, the person just has to press start. In officer mode, you have to befriend a charicter before you can place them as a fellow officer, but once you have at least one officer (again, not including yourself) befriended, your brother would just has to press start at the Allies screen, after you put the character in as an officer.

x360-dynasty-warriors-7.exp: The two player online co-op mode will feature greater challenges and tougher enemies - it's called Conquest .

x360-earth-defense-force-2017.exp: Two players can play through the missions together with a vertically split screen.

x360-earth-defense-force-2025.exp: Crush the Ravager menace with friends via two player local co-op, four player online co-op, or combo co-op.

x360-earth-defense-force-insect-armagedd.exp: 3 players can team up through the campaign while 6 players can team up for a survival mode!

x360-earthworm-jim-hd.exp: Each player takes the role of a Earthworm Jim character through co-op specific levels.

x360-elements-of-destruction.exp: Players must use forces of nature to destroy buildings and objects. In the Co-Op mode both players have control over their own forces and work together to create destruction as quickly as possible.

x360-epic-mickey-2-the-power-of-two.exp: Join Mickey and Oswald in an epic battle to save the magical world of Wasteland and change it forever.

x360-eragon.exp: Play as Eragon and his dragon as they set out to fulfill their destiny. Endure perilous travels, adventure and heart-pounding combat as you live the epic events of the movie. Disable and dispatch enemies with the unparalleled skills of a true Dragon Ride. Eragon's combat system features a variety of blistering attacks and defences, including a unique degradable block system. Extensive Dragon Combat � Ride Saphira and blast your enemies with bursts of fire, and call in devastating dragon attacks during melee battles. Eragon features multiplayer co-op with team attack bonuses and dragon fight/flight combo gameplay.

x360-eternal-sonata.exp: Each players can control a character during the game's realtime battle system.

x360-f-e-a-r-3.exp: Players can take the role of point man, the main character from previous FEAR titles or Fettel, a pscho-kintetic character that can inhabit the bodies of enemies in two player local or online co-op.In addition the game features two survival style online co-op modes for four players.

x360-f1-2011.exp: Join up with a friend to play through a season as a co-op team.

x360-f1-2012.exp: The game will offer a host of "new features, wide-ranging technical and gameplay advancements and extensive competitive and co-operative multiplayer components", plus all the official teams, drivers and circuits from the 2012 season.

x360-f1-2013.exp: Two players can do a championship on the same team. While only one can win the title of course, there is still room to work together e.g. to get the Constructors’ title for your chosen team and help each other to get on the podium in general.

x360-fable-heroes.exp: Up to four people can brawl together in any combination of online and offline players, dropping in or out at any time. Empty spots are filled by AI players. While the combat is cooperative, players ordinarily compete to earn gold for themselves. Enabling Family mode shares the gold evenly across the group.

x360-fairytale-fights.exp: Team up with a friend to hack and slash you way through fairytale inspired worlds.

x360-family-guy-back-to-the-multiverse.exp: Play as Stewie and Brian in local 2 player split screen co-op throughout the campaign and/or in a series of challenges.

x360-fantasia-music-evolved.exp: Up to two players create and alter music utilizing the Kinect.

x360-fantastic-four-rise-of-the-silver-s.exp: Marvel's first superhero family must face its greatest challenge yet - the mysterious Silver Surfer! Follow an all-new plot as you chase the Surfer around the world and face the unlikely return of the Fantastic 4's mortal enemy, Dr. Doom. Combine powers to create devastating team attacks against your enemies. Play as any member of the team and use their specific abilities to solve puzzles and destroy opposition. Take on more than just the Silver Surfer - battle Red Ghost, Terrax, and Super Skrull as you try to save the world from destruction!

x360-far-cry-3.exp: Four players can can battle through 6 co-op missions with various objectives. Players will earn experience and can unlock abilities, weapons and more.

x360-far-cry-4.exp: Two players can take on the outpost assaults and some open world stuff within the campaign with a friend.

x360-feeding-frenzy-2-shipwreck-showdown.exp: Two players can play local co-op throughout the story mode or a number of minigames.

x360-fifa-15.exp: Up to four players can play against an AI-controlled team in both exhibition matches and in the game's Manager Mode.

x360-final-exam.exp: In cooperative mode, up to four players (local and online) team up to survive. Split up to fill your objectives as fast as possible, or stay together in a cohesive team to increase your chances of survival.

x360-fire-pro-wrestling.exp: Play with a buddy in local or online tag matches against the AI.

x360-fist-of-the-north-star-ken-s-rage-2.exp: Two online players use super martial arts to destroy post apocalyptic gangs.

x360-forza-horizon.exp: Before the servers were shut down, in free roam mode you could form a crew of up to eight players and take on co-op challenges together like driving 8.000 miles or going from a point on the map to another in a specific car model. The host decides which co-op challenge the lobby will tackle.

x360-forza-horizon-2.exp: Team up with another player online to tackle a variety of challenges on the "Co-Op Bucket List"

x360-foul-play.exp: Foul Play supports two player online and local co-op. Two players team up as Baron Dashforth and Mr. Swampwick to brawl with daemons using their arsenal of abilities and tag team moves.

x360-fret-nice.exp: Two players can team up via couch co-op.

x360-frogger.exp: In the Co-Op mode the screen splits and both players work together to achieve a combined high score.

x360-front-mission-evolved.exp: Co-Op is only available via a piece of premium DLC called the "Last Stand."Endless swarms of the enemy are invading. Can you and your team hold them off? Multiplayer co-op mode.

x360-fruit-ninja-kinect.exp: Two players can team up locally in Team Arcade Mode

x360-fuse.exp: Engage in lethal co-op in this sqaud-based shooter. Fuse supports two player local co-op, four player online co-op, and combo co-op in both the main campaign and the wave-based Echelon mode.

x360-fusion-genesis.exp: Up to four friends can join the same faction and take on group missions together. Strangely, each player must complete said mission objectives separately as progress isn’t shared among the group. Three types of special missions offer much more substantial cooperative gameplay and unique rewards.

x360-g-i-joe-the-rise-of-cobra.exp: Players team up by choosing one of 16 playable GI Joe characters in this 3rd person shooter. The game also features 2 player co-op driving sequences.

x360-gatling-gears.exp: Take control of a customized mech and destroy enemies with a friend.

x360-gauntlet.exp: One to four players play together on Xbox Live multiplayer game mode.

x360-gears-of-war-judgment.exp: The campaign supports two player local co-op, four player online co-op, and combo co-op. Survival mode supports two player local co-op, five player online co-op, and combo co-op. All MP matches can be populated with AI bots for even more cooperative options.

x360-geometry-wars-3-dimensions.exp: Up to four players team up through 10 challenging levels designed solely for co-op play. Teams attempt to achieve star goals with individual multipliers, but combined scores.

x360-ghostbusters-sanctum-of-slime.exp: Players can team up as their own character and work together to bring down ghosts and large bosses.

x360-ghostbusters-the-video-game.exp: Online-only co-op allows four players to bust ghosts, earn cash, and level up together through a variety of familiar and unique instant-action game modes.

x360-go-go-break-steady.exp: Up to two players can play the same songs together both locally and online. During the rhythm segments, the worst input of both players is counted. For the beatnik puzzle, both players take turns.

x360-goat-simulator.exp: Players are be able to play the game in a split-screen mode with two players and wreak goat havoc on the world.

x360-god-mode.exp: Team up with friends to earn customizations for your character.

x360-golden-axe.exp: Three mighty heroes have a score to settle with the evil Death Adder in this classic action game, now adapted for Xbox LIVE� Arcade. As a powerful fighter, a female Amazon, or a mighty dwarf, fight through Adder's henchmen with weapon and magic attacks, or ride the fearsome, fire-breathing dragon in Golden Axe. Now you and a friend can join in on the action.

x360-grand-slam-tennis-2.exp: Play doubles with a friend against the AI.

x360-grand-theft-auto-episodes-from-libe.exp: Both titles offer the ability to free-roam the city with your friends. In addition The Lost and Damned has the multiplayer mode Club Business. This is a co-operative, task-based game similar to Mafiya Work in Grand Theft Auto IV with an emphasis on The Lost Motorcycle club's primary activitesClub Business: a co-operative, task-based game similar to Mafiya Work in Grand Theft Auto IV with an emphasis on The Lost Motorcycle club's primary activites.

x360-grand-theft-auto-iv.exp: The game offers a few cooperative options. It should be noted that playing through the single player story is not available in co-op play. Hangman's Noose You and your 1-3 friends must take down the cops guarding a crime boss, Kenny, who's on a grounded plane at the airport. There's a few options here to tweak the mission and make it dynamic. There's also some cut scenes and dialog to go along with it. BOMB DA BASE II

x360-grease-dance.exp: Game includes Dance Mode and Karaoke Mode with both featuring versus and co-operative play.

x360-green-day-rock-band.exp: Solid four-player co-op with the same vocal harmonies as The Beatles Rock Band.

x360-guacamelee-super-turbo-championship.exp: A Mexican-themed 2 player local co-op-multiplayer dimension-swapping Metroid-vania beat-em-up platformer

x360-guardian-heroes.exp: Play through the full story mode as a team either locally or online. With five characters to choose from (the fifth must be unlocked by beating the game on Normal first) and numerous paths to take, co-op has lots of replay value. Just make sure to choose Easy difficulty or your team will likely run out of lives before reaching the end.

x360-guardians-of-middle-earth.exp: Team up against the AI in a skirmish mode or custom matches. Player choose class based characters with complimenting abilities from the Lord of the Rings franchise.

x360-guilty-gear-2-overture.exp: Take on a team of bots with a friend in 2vs2 matches.

x360-guitar-hero-aerosmith.exp: The co-op career mode has each player as the lead guitar or bass guitar playing through set lists to unlock more songs. The co-op career doesn't contain the cutscenes of the single player career.

x360-guitar-hero-ii.exp: One player plays the lead guitar, the other bass.

x360-guitar-hero-iii-legends-of-rock.exp: Offers local co-op and battle modes as well as online equivalents.

x360-guitar-hero-smash-hits.exp: The Guitar Hero franchise continues as a full band experience. Background The setlist will include the best of Guitar Hero 1, 2, and 3, plus the Rocks the 80s expansion.

x360-guitar-hero-van-halen.exp: Play through the game's song as a drummer, guitar, bass or singer just like the real band. Long hair not required or included!

x360-guitar-hero-warriors-of-rock.exp: Play as a band with friends in an all new "Quest mode" or quick play songs in traditional music game fashion. Supports drop-in/drop-out play.

x360-guitar-hero-world-tour.exp: Four players, three instruments plus vocals = rock the house.

x360-guncraft-blocked-and-loaded.exp: Team up in Onslaught mode where you'll need to build up your base and survive waves of enemies.

x360-gunstar-heroes.exp: Team up by choosing one of many characters through this unique side scrolling game. It's similar to Contra, but with quite a bit more depth.

x360-guwange.exp: One or two players can take on the armies of Shikigami together.

x360-halo-3.exp: Player one will control the Master Chief, player two will control the Arbiter and players three and four will control two new Elite characters: N'tho 'Sraom and Usze 'Taham.

x360-halo-3-odst.exp: A brand new entry into the Halo universe as players take the role of an OSDT Marine. Players can play through the campaign or choose a survival mode called FireFight.

x360-halo-reach.exp: Play through the campaign in four player co-op. More co-op information is coming.

x360-halo-spartan-assault.exp: Take on five co-op missions with a friend against the Flood. Co-Op specific levels require coordination and teamwork to survive and conquer.

x360-happy-wars.exp: Until the servers were shut down on 12/16/18 a team of up to 15 players could comp stomp AI teams in a series of three increasingly difficult matches. Co-op moves include building towers and other structures together, healing and resurrecting team mates, and Team Skills that require multiple participants to perform.

x360-hard-corps-uprising.exp: Run and gun with a buddy either online or off.

x360-harms-way.exp: Harms Way is a fast paced, action packed race where both drivers and snipers need to team up to win the race. As the sniper, you need to blow-up the competition. As a driver you need to finish 3 laps first.

x360-heavy-weapon.exp: Each player controls a tank that they upgrade with various weapon types between levels. Work together to shoot down ever increasing amounts of enemies.

x360-hellboy-the-science-of-evil.exp: Play as Abe Sapien or Liz Sherman in co-op through the single player story.

x360-how-to-survive.exp: Players can team up with other survivors in local or online multiplayer story and challenge modes to take on a growing array of the infected. As of now the local and online co-op differs slighty in terms of story.

x360-hunted-the-demon-s-forge.exp: Contro E'larra or Caddoc through this action fantasy game.Combine E’lara’s ranged attacks with Caddoc’s melee expertise to pull off gruesome co-op kill moves, perform special attacks, and heal one another regardless of where they in relation to one another on the battlefield. The characters’ differing combat methods allow player strategy to vary from one playthrough to the next.

x360-ihf-handball-challenge-14.exp: Up to four players can take control of the players on a team and take on the AI.

x360-ikaruga.exp: With the unique light and dark system, the co-op experience requires players to work together to maximize score, and stay alive longer!

x360-ilomilo.exp: Two players can work together to solve puzzles and explore the world of ilomilo.

x360-instant-brain.exp: The included version of DoDonPachi allows for two players to play through the whole game together.

x360-interpol-the-trail-of-dr-chaos.exp: Hunt for clues with your friends in this puzzle/adventure game. You are required to locate objects in a scene.

x360-inversion.exp: Players can play through the campaign in 2-player online co-op as either Davis Russel or Leo Delgado as they fight off the Lutadore invaders. Alternatively, players can team up in a 4-player survival mode.

x360-invincible-tiger-the-legend-of-han-.exp: Team up with a fellow Invincible Tiger and beat down ninjas like a crazy fool.

x360-ion-assault.exp: Play the campaign with a friend in Co-op mode

x360-iron-brigade.exp: Team up with three other players and show off your customized Trenched Mech as you work together. The game also features a revive mechanic and will scale difficulty based on the number of players.

x360-joust.exp: Probably one of the first co-op games ever created, each player takes control of a bird rider as they take down enemy bird riders. Players work together to achieve high scores.

x360-juju.exp: Grab a friend or family member for two-player cooperative play. JUJU is enjoyable for all skill-levels and allows the second player to jump in or out any time.

x360-just-dance-2014.exp: In the new 'One Stage Mode,' one main dancer can lead two back-up dancers who are also encouraged to sing along if they choose. All players are scored the same way as regular gameplay. Just Dance 2014 on the Xbox 360 also features a four-player simultaneous dance mode.

x360-just-dance-2015.exp: Grab a few limber friends and synchronize your dance moves in songs that support two, three or four simultaneous players.

x360-just-dance-2017.exp: Up to six players can dance together.

x360-just-dance-2019.exp: Grab a few limber friends and synchronize your dance moves in songs that support two, three, or four simultaneous players

x360-just-dance-disney-party-2.exp: Grab a few limber friends and synchronize your dance moves in songs that support two, three or four simultaneous players.

x360-just-dance-kids-2.exp: Grab a few limber friends and synchronize your dance moves in songs that support two, three or four simultaneous players.

x360-just-dance-kids-2014.exp: Up to four players can dance together to a song. There's also a duet-mode for two players.

x360-kane-and-lynch-2-dog-days.exp: Play as either Kane or Lynch through the campaign.The online co-op modes from the first game return as well.

x360-kane-and-lynch-dead-men.exp: Players take control of either Kane or Lynch as they play through the single player story in offline co-op.

x360-ketsui-kizuna-jigoku-tachi-extra.exp: A second player can join in at any time with their own ship and start shooting away.

x360-kinect-disneyland-adventures.exp: Two players can explore the park together, with the main player controlling navigation. Both players can interact with famous Disney characters and participate in the attraction minigames together.

x360-kinect-party.exp: Kinect Party's minigames can track up to six players at once. Players work together to pop balloons, shoot down enemies, and more. Some minigames work better with less people, as standing in front of each other can cause players to disappear. The game is definitely intended to be played with others though.

x360-kinect-rush-a-disney-pixar-adventur.exp: A friend can join in for split-screen play at any time. Both players can take separate pathways to find hidden coins and items, and complete co-op puzzles in order to progress through each level. There are also separate leaderboards for co-op.

x360-kinect-star-wars.exp: Go on a Star Wars adventure together in Jedi Destiny mode, lock lightsabers with opponents in Duels of Fate, smash buildings and droids in Rancor Rampage, and dance along with classic Star Wars characters in the goofy Galactic Dance mode. The second player gets a split-screen in all but Galactic Dance. Each of these modes supports drop-in, drop-out play.

x360-kingdom-under-fire-circle-of-doom.exp: Kingdom Under Fire� Circle of Doom is an action role-playing game set in another dimension with randomly generated maps. Save the world from eternal darkness as you battle hordes of enemies using your skills to build powerful weapon combos for each hero. Take your game online with the seamlessly integrated multiplayer over Xbox LIVE�.

x360-kung-fu-strike-the-warrior-s-rise.exp: Take on the main campaign with a friend (albeit in a separate multiplayer mode). Enemy encounters double and if either player runs out of health they both get a Game Over, so co-op may be more challenging than single-player.

x360-lara-croft-and-the-guardian-of-ligh.exp: Play as Lara or Totec in this isometric view shooter/puzzle hybrid where players must work together to kill enemies and solve environmental puzzles.

x360-leedmees.exp: Team up with a friend as your whole body controls the platforming elements on the screen.This game requires Kinect.

x360-left-4-dead.exp: Fight with up to 4 other players against the impending zombie horde. Cover, heal, revive, and protect your teammates. Full drop in and drop out support including the ability to "pause" your character and let the AI take over. The online splitscreen mode requires a guest sign in or a gold account.

x360-left-4-dead-2.exp: Take the role of a different set of survivors as you use all new blunt force weapons, chainsaws and new guns in the sequel to Left 4 Dead. Teamwork is even more crucial as high intensity moments require greater communication to survive.

x360-lego-batman-3-beyond-gotham.exp: 2-player co-op similar to previous LEGO games.

x360-lego-dimensions.exp: Play Alone or with a Friend. Players can let imagination guide their solo journey or have a friend join the adventure with co-operative, drop-in/drop-out play.

x360-lego-harry-potter-years-1-4.exp: LEGO meets Harry Potter, what more can be said? The game has a dynamic split screen feature.

x360-lego-indiana-jones-2-the-adventure-.exp: LEGO action returns to the Indiana Jones world. New features include split screen co-op and a level editor.

x360-lego-indiana-jones-the-original-adv.exp: Team up with a buddy and play through the original trilogy of Indiana Jones movies in a style only Lego can do. This family friendly game allows each player to choose a character, or customize their own. The LEGO games mix platform and action elements in a a very family friendly game.

x360-lego-jurassic-world.exp: You and a friend will be able to control one character each throughout the stories of all four games.

x360-lego-marvel-super-heroes.exp: Lego Marvel Super Heroes lets you take control of your favorite Marvel heroes with over 100 unlockable characters, including Spider-Man, Iron Man, Wolverine, Captain America, the Hulk, Thor, Black Widow, Hawkeye, Deadpool, Loki and Galactus. 2 player local co-op will be featured throughout the campaign

x360-lego-pirates-of-the-caribbean-the-v.exp: the game will span the stories of the first three films (The Curse of the Black Pearl, Dead Man's Chest and At World's End), as well as the fourth film (On Stranger Tides) and will feature over 70 characters from the franchise. The game will also feature its flagship drop-in, drop-out co-op gameplay mechanic.

x360-lego-rock-band.exp: Jam out with your friends LEGO style, in a more "pop" version of the Rock Band franchise. Players use drums, guitar, bass or vocals to play.

x360-lego-star-wars-ii-the-original-tril.exp: A second player can jump in at any time and take control of the second character.

x360-lego-star-wars-iii-the-clone-wars.exp: Complete various objectives, players will control multiple teams in separate locations in co-op.

x360-lego-star-wars-the-complete-saga.exp: From the Trade Federation's "negotiations" with Obi-Wan Kenobi and Qui-Gon Jinn in The Phantom Menace to the space battle above Endor in Return of the Jedi, The Complete Saga allows players to kick some brick through 36 Story Mode levels, including Episode II's newly added high-speed pursuit of bounty hunter Zam Wessell. Traveller�s Tales has revamped levels from the original LEGO Star Wars to match the gameplay evolutions found in LEGO Star Wars II, and Prequel Trilogy characters can now be mixed and matched with those from the Original Trilogy � more than 160 in all. [LucasArts]

x360-lego-star-wars-the-force-awakens.exp: Two players can play through the entirety of the game's campaign and additional adventures

x360-lego-the-hobbit.exp: Play as any of the fellowship in this LEGO creation of The Hobbit.

x360-lego-the-lord-of-the-rings.exp: Play as any of the fellowship in this LEGO creation of LOTR.

x360-let-s-sing-and-dance.exp: Two dancers and as many singers as you can summon to the party.

x360-lode-runner.exp: Lode Runner features 2 player co-op "journey" campaigns. More info as it's available.

x360-lost-planet-2.exp: Form teams of up to 4 players online to clear mission objectives with friends.

x360-lucha-fury.exp: Team up with friends and choose 1 of 4 characters to play.

x360-madagascar-3-the-video-game.exp: 2 local players can wander through the cities on fetch quests together in split screen mode. Each character's special powers are needed to progress.

x360-madballs-in-babo-invasion.exp: This arcade style shooter looks to be Assault Heroes meets Marble Blast Ultra as up to four players take control of a madball and destroy everything in their path.

x360-madden-nfl-11.exp: The local co-op plays like traditional Madden where each player can control and cycle through different positional players.Online co-op gives players a unique view and camera. You can only play quick games in online co-op.

x360-magic-the-gathering-duels-of-the-pl.exp: Team up against the AI in the Co-Op Campaign.

x360-marathon-durandal.exp: Seventeen years ago, you survived a vicious Pfhor assault on the U.E.S.C. Marathon. Now you have been awakened by the enigmatic, sentient A.I. called Durandal and sent to an alien world to uncover the mysteries of their advanced technology. In Marathon: Durandal, armed with only a pistol, you are humanity�s last champion! Marathon: Durandal supports four-player split-screen offline and eight-player online co-op.

x360-marvel-avengers-battle-for-earth.exp: Player Campaign or Arcade mode in tag-team co-op. When the active player raises his or her arm, the inactive player jumps in. The inactive player can perform the same super move as the active player to help the active player do more damage. If either player runs out of life, the team loses the round.

x360-marvel-super-hero-squad-the-infinit.exp: Co-Op Play Play with friends as you drop into gameplay as well as change characters in order to solve and overcome different kinds of obstacles. Form your own squad with up to three friends and choose from the 30 heroes and villains from the Marvel Universe

x360-marvel-ultimate-alliance-2.exp: Join up with three other friends as you choose a super hero and combine powers for "Fusion" attacks. Until the online servers where shutdown in 2020, online multiplayer was also available.

x360-matt-hazard-blood-bath-and-beyond.exp: Play on your own as Matt Hazard, or with a buddy as Matt�s old sidekick Dexter Dare in Co-op gameplay mode. Think Contra...on crack.

x360-max-payne-3.exp: In Dead Men Walking co-op mode, fight waves of enemies as Max and Passos, earning Grit, which is used to unlock new areas of the map, weapons, weapon attachments and ammo. This mode was added as paid DLC on 1.22.2013 and is a required add-on for cooperative play.

x360-megamind-ultimate-showdown.exp: The second player takes on the role of trusty Brainbot who is a secondary character to assist in puzzles.

x360-mercenaries-2-world-in-flames.exp: Background: World powers with deep pockets are willing to pay you to create chaos and do their dirty work. Mercenaries 2 features the latest and most dangerous in civilian and military tech, everything from tanks, APCs, boats, shiny new sports cars, to even a satellite-guided bunker-busting mini-nuke. These are your tools, use them well. You are not a soldier. You are a mercenary. Everyone will try and screw you, given the chance. They think they can get away with it, because they don't know rule number one: Everybody pays. Play the main campaign with the help of your friends. Jump in and out of a game at any time.

x360-metal-slug-3.exp: Marco, Tarma, Eri, and Fio, the four veterans of the elite Sparrows Unit now come to Xbox LIVE� in METAL SLUG 3�! The popular action shooting series is in all of its original arcade glory, with gorgeous graphics and all the run-and-gun action you can handle. There is no time for indecision. General Morden is on the warpath and you must prevent him from creating the New World Order. Stop the Rebel Army!

x360-metal-slug-xx.exp: Play through the game with another person to complete missions in this bullet hell like scrolling shooter. Each player has their own pool of lives.

x360-microbot.exp: Team up through the single player missions or take on the challenge missions in a survival style gameplay mode. Players can also tweak their co-op experience using the "co-op editor."

x360-mighty-no-9.exp: Take on over a dozen missions online with a friend, playing as Beck and his partner, Call! Use Beck and Call’s different powers together in order to defeat these special challenges!

x360-mindjack.exp: Mindjack allows players to take control of any character in a game. Co-Op gamers can seamlessly join a friends game to help out as long as the host player is still alive.Other gamers can take control of enemies as well, turning the game into a versus type mode, but you can disable it. This would make it 3vs3

x360-minecraft-xbox-360-edition.exp: Up to four players can split-screen to build, hunt, harvest, and explore together offline. Split-screen requires the Xbox 360 to be running at 720P or higher resolution via an HDMI, DVI, VGA, or component cable. Online co-op supports up to 8 players, which can consist of any combination of split-screen players.

x360-mlb-bobblehead-pros.exp: Two players can team up, either locally or online, to control a team in tandem or turn play.

x360-monaco-what-s-yours-is-mine.exp: Team up with up to four people on the same screen or online to steal everything that isn't nailed down

x360-monday-night-combat.exp: Team up in Blitz mode where you must defend your money ball against waves of AI enemies. Money earned from destroying the robots can be used to upgrade your character during combat or building different turrets around the base. Players can team up two on a box and play online for four players total.

x360-moon-diver.exp: The Diver System allows players to jump in or out at any time, for a maximum of up to four players total. Guest players are awarded experience points for helping out.Combos increase in power and intensity according to the number of players. Collect new combo moves by picking them up on the map or fulfilling certain requirements.

x360-mr-driller-online.exp: Details coming on the Co-Op aspect of the game.

x360-ms-splosion-man.exp: The sequel to the platformer 'Splosion Man. Blast through levels with up to three other people either locally or online.

x360-mushihime-sama-futari.exp: A second player can join in at any time and shoot away.

x360-mushihimesama.exp: A second player can join in at any time and shoot away.

x360-mutant-storm-empire.exp: There's this evil emperor, see, and � well, he's evil. Now someone has decided to put a stop to the whole evilness thing, and that someone is you. It's the right thing to do! Besides, in Mutant Storm Empire, it'll be fun. Battle through line after line of the emperor's minion horde, destroying absolutely everything you can! Blast through bunches of robots, crush colonies of aquatic monsters, smash swarms of UFOs, and demolish devastating bosses. It's a continuous adventure through four immense, strikingly vibrant worlds, and you can fight alone or join forces with a friend in two-player cooperative mode. Enjoy the frenzy!

x360-mutant-storm-reloaded.exp: Mutant Storm Reloaded features the official training grounds for those who wish to master Blastikkidoo�the Art of Blasting. Just as in martial arts, you begin with a white belt and earn higher belts as you progress. As you move to higher belts, the difficulty increases, which in turn hones your skill. Your goal is simple: Blast through 89 levels inhabited by an array of nasty beasties and live to brag about it. Survive, and you could earn the elusive black belt. Play single player, or two-player cooperative on the same console in either Adventure Mode or Tally Mode.

x360-n-plus.exp: 4 Player Online Co-Op isn't verified yet. Co-op Mode comes in two flavors: standard and MP. Basic Co-Op has players working together through the standard set of single-player levels. MP Mode - Gives players a whole new set of levels, especially designed for multiplayer gameplay.

x360-narco-terror.exp: Two players can team up and dish out steaming plates of leaded justice in drop-in/drop-out local or online co-op.

x360-neverdead.exp: Up to four players can take on Neverdead's online missions together. Of the 13 on-disc missions, 8 are co-op and 5 are competitive. Co-op mission types include Arena Onslaught (defeat waves of enemies in an enclosed arena), Search and Rescue (escort civilians to safety), and Onslaught (clear enemies out of a large level). Experience earned in multiplayer carries over to the main game.

x360-nhl-10.exp: NHL 10 offers traditional offline play for up to 4 players. Each person can lock themselves to a player position and work together as a team to win hockey games.Online play is a bit different, while you can't play 6 players against the AI, the experience is extremely co-op. A online league is created and you'll play from a unique camera perspective for your position. Your custom team will face off against other teams of 2 or more players. There's no voice chat between teams - so no trash talking - but there is voicechat among your own team.

x360-nhl-11.exp: All of the game's modes can be played in co-op locally with the exception of the shootout.Online co-op is only a quick, unranked match called online team play. Players can lock into a position.

x360-ninja-gaiden-3.exp: Team up with a friend through co-op missions inspired by the game's single player campaign.

x360-ninja-gaiden-3-razor-s-edge.exp: Two players can join up online in Ninja Trials as custom ninjas, or story characters Ayane, Ryu, Kasumi, or Momiji (after unlocking them). Ninja Trials is a survival mode where players will have to defeat multiple waves of enemies. Higher difficulties can be unlocked.

x360-omega-five.exp: Omega Five is a true next-gen, high-definition shooter, with the most awe-inspiring graphics around. Fly through dangerous 3-D environments in this side-scroller as enemies come at you from all sides, even the background. Grab an extra controller, choose your merc, and engage in two-player local co-op play for more action.

x360-omerta-city-of-gangsters.exp: Team up with a friend online to complete missions.

x360-onechanbara-bikini-samurai-squad.exp: Slice and dice your way through hordes of relentless zombies as bikini clad babes. Both you and your buddy control one of the Onechanbara in this Devil May Cry style action game.

x360-operation-flashpoint-red-river.exp: The core game is built around its four player co-op campaign, but Red River will also feature separate co-op modes with various objectives.

x360-otomedius-excellent.exp: Play with up to three players on one console or via Xbox Live. Set the starting level, wave, and difficulty, and then do your best! If the first player runs out of lives, it's game over for everyone. In online games, players two and three must wait for player one to reach checkpoints before they can respawn.

x360-otomedius-gorgeous.exp: Up to three players can play both the Gorgeous (campaign) as well as the Vs. mission mode (Boss Rush) together with each controlling their own ship.

x360-outland.exp: Story co-op and co-op challenge rooms for two online players.

x360-overlord.exp: Each player takes the role of an Overlord in the co-op mode. Free DLC is required to enable split screen play.

x360-overlord-ii.exp: Arena Survival � Two players, both as overlords with their own minions, help each other stay alive as they battle against wave after wave of enemies coming at them in an arena setting. Kill A General � Two players, both as overlords with their own minions, go through a series of lands together on a mission to kill a Glorious Empire general.

x360-payday-2.exp: Up to 4 players take perform multiple bank heists and robberies spanning over 30 missions. Gameplay is heavily improved and expanded since it's prequel, with a number of new abilities and items.

x360-perfect-dark-zero.exp: Joanna Dark returns in this prequel to the award-winning Perfect Dark, in a first-person shooter exclusively for Xbox 360. When a routine bounty-hunting mission reveals a vast conspiracy, Joanna is sucked into the battle for global domination. Mold Joanna into the perfect agent as you navigate a murky world of corporate intrigue and espionage. Many weapons, vehicles, and gadgets from the original game return. Hordes of new ones are added, creating a massive arsenal that includes jetpacks, motorcycles, hovercraft, and other cutting-edge weapons technology. Max out replayability with single-player, four-player splitscreen, co-op, and other multiplayer options.

x360-phantom-breaker-battle-grounds.exp: Battle through the game in 4-player co-op.

x360-pid.exp: In Pid's local co-op mode, each player controls a single beam of his or her own. That means they have to work together to cross gaps and avoid hazards.

x360-pirates-vs-ninjas-dodgeball.exp: Engage in classic dodgeball action with Pirates, Ninjas, Robots and more! Work together to defeat the opposing team, or take it online for some 4 vs 4 action.

x360-plants-vs-zombies.exp: 2 player co-op throughout Adventure Mode, plus a dedicated Co-Op Mode where each player has his or her own plants to cultivate.

x360-portal-2.exp: Portal 2 will have a co-op campaign. Players take control of a robot and work through puzzles that require two players to work together to solve.

x360-power-gig-rise-of-the-sixstring.exp: The game offers three player co-op - lead guitar, vocals and drums. Co-Op play is available through the game's "story" mode.

x360-pro-evolution-soccer-2018.exp: Team up with two other players online to take on a computer controlled team. The console version of the game allows for a second local player in the co-op mode, and also supports combo co-op, i.e., two players locally and one online

x360-puzzle-arcade.exp: Create and Solve classic shape puzzles with friends. Only 2 players are available to play in "Turbo" mode. You can not save puzzle progress in co-op mode.

x360-r-i-p-d-rest-in-peace-department-th.exp: Two-player online or system link co-op allows wanna-be gunslingers to use teamwork as they battle their way through the game.

x360-radiant-silvergun.exp: Two players can play through the game together however the unlocks don't carry over to the Story mode for either player.

x360-radirgy-noa-massive.exp: Two local players can team up to take on enemies.

x360-rage.exp: Legends of the Wasteland is a 9 mission separate co-op campaign.

x360-raiden-iv.exp: Team up with a fellow fighter pilot as you collect powerups and dodge bullets in this traditional top down vertical shooter.

x360-rainbow-islands-towering-adventure.exp: A second player can join in and climb the tower with you.

x360-rayman-legends.exp: Four player co-op is supported with four players controlling their own unique characters.

x360-raystorm-hd.exp: Team up with a friend in this SHMUP remake.

x360-renegade-ops.exp: Team up online with up to four people for destructive co-op action.

x360-resident-evil-5.exp: The entire Resident Evil 5 campaign supports two player, drop-in/drop-out co-op either locally (i.e., couch co-op), via system link or online. Co-op is also supported in the story DLC, "Lost in Nightmares" and "Desperate Escape." Additionally, two player local or online co-op is supported in the "Mercenaries United" mode.

x360-resident-evil-6.exp: Team up through the game's story with one of 6 different characters (3 stories, 2 characters each) and team up for four player co-op through specific intersection moments. The game also supports a two player co-op mercenary mode.

x360-resident-evil-operation-raccoon-cit.exp: Choose one of six specially trained members of the Umbrella Security Service. Form a four man team and destroy all evidence of Umbrella Corporation's involvement in the Raccoon City Outbreak.

x360-resident-evil-revelations-2.exp: Assistive co-op play - Players will work together as the two characters to overcome the nightmares in couch co-op. Utilize Moira's torch to temporarily blind the enemy before Claire takes them out! Raid Mode returns from Resident Evil: Revelations, allowing two players to team up against a horde of enemies. The Raid Mode for Resident Evil: Revelations 2 allows for two player local co-op or two player online co-op.

x360-rock-revolution.exp: Play either drums, lead guitar or bass guitar in Konami's entry into the rhythm and music wars. Release your inner rockstar or allow your friends the privilege of picking up guitar, bass, drums, and microphone peripherals to 40 rock and roll tracks. Online and offline multiplayer, versus, coop and band battle with rehearsal mode and career mode. [KONAMI]

x360-rocketmen-axis-of-evil.exp: The game features customizable characters and up to 4 players in co-op, either online or off. Update: On May 14th, 2008 Capcom has released an expansion pack titled Rocketmen: It Came from Your Uranus for $4.95. The add-on adds 5 new weapons and 3 new levels and allows you to upgrade your character even further. Players will join the heroes of the Alliance of Free Planets in their white-knuckled, frenzied struggle to free the Solar System from the tyrannical grip of the Legion of Terra. Up to four players will be able to cooperatively shoot their way through multiple levels, powering up their weapons, picking up bonuses and laying waste to anything that moves.

x360-rocksmith.exp: Using a (separately sold) second Real Tone Cable two players can rock out to the same song together with each player choosing which instrument to play and their own skill levels.

x360-root-beer-tapper.exp: Get ready to serve! Rediscover the classic arcade game Root Beer Tapper on Xbox Live�. Take on a room full of thirsty folks and keep their mugs full as they belly up to the bar, but don't drop the empties if you want to win. Play online in either co-op or versus modes and post scores on the Xbox Live leaderboards. The best scores are kept for the current week and for all time for both co-op and versus matches.

x360-rush-n-attack.exp: In Rush'n Attack, the enemy holds prisoners of war deep in their base and it's up to you to rescue them. Using your trusty knife and other weapons you find, fight your way through four stages of increasing difficulty to free your compatriots and escape to safety.[XBOX.COM]

x360-sacred-2-fallen-angel.exp: You have the option of running co-op campaigns, where you and a few friends (up to 4) can go through the main story of the game, leave it open in a free for all where only secondary quests can be played and the entire map is available to explore, and arena modes where the same groups can fight waves of enemies or each other. Enemies scale up and down as players drop in or out, keeping the balance even. You don't have to keep playing with the group if you want to be alone, just go to your own game and come back when you are ready for more multiplayer action. In Depth Details of the Online Play can be found here.

x360-sacred-3.exp: Team up in four player co-op through the campaign. Utilize weapon spirits to maximize your co-op team and buff teammates with unique abilities.

x360-sacred-citadel.exp: Up to three players can join forces in local or online co-op throughout the entire campaign.

x360-saints-row.exp: The game only offers two missions (three with the DLC) designed for two players. Outside of these missions no co-op options are available.

x360-saints-row-2.exp: The sandbox just got larger with a totally transformed and expanded city of Stilwater, offering all new locations to explore with new vehicles, including motorcycles, boats, helicopters and planes. Saints Row 2 will be playable online in 2-player co-op through the entire single-player campaign or in the all new open-world competitive multiplayer mode never before seen in the genre.

x360-saints-row-gat-out-of-hell.exp: Play as Johnny Gat or Kinzie Kensington - For the first time ever, play as the fan favorites Johnny Gat and Kinzie Kensington, alone or in 2-player online co-op

x360-saints-row-iv.exp: Play through the entire game with a friend - bring in your own character with all of your customizations and upgrades. Both players keep the spoils of the Saints.

x360-saints-row-the-third.exp: The entire Saints Row: The Third experience can be enjoyed by two players through online play or system link. The game requires an online pass for co-op play.

x360-sanctum-2.exp: Sanctum 2 is a sequel 2009's Sanctum, a hybrid FPS/Tower Defense game. To succeed you have to construct and upgrade defensive structures. What makes Sanctum unique from other tower defenses is that when the havoc starts, you jump right into the action with your own weapons and play a key role in the defense.

x360-scarygirl.exp: The entire game supports drop-in, drop-out co-op. The second player controls Bunniguru, ScaryGirl's martial artist sidekick. An offensive character with unique martial arts moves, he can't grapple enemies or the environment like Scarygirl. Together they can perform team up moves.

x360-schizoid.exp: Schizoid is a co-op action game in which teamwork matters like never before, as gamers and their friend or AI ally protect each other from barrages of glowing enemies. Co-op gameplay to the max: No other multiplayer co-op game has such tight cooperative gameplay. The two players (or one player with a computer A.I. partner, or one player controlling both ships in Uberschizoid) must work together closely in order to defeat the hordes on each level.

x360-scourge-outbreak.exp: Players team up for the game's campaign, each taken a role as a different character. Character abilities differ slightly and cut scenes are specific to a character's viewpoint.

x360-scramble.exp: Scramble your fighter and take on the enemy base in this newly enhanced version of the arcade classic. The base is heavily guarded and you must guide your ship through five levels of enemy defenses before you can destroy your objective. Featuring brand-new graphics and sounds for Xbox 360�, take your skills online and challenge the new "Versus" and "Co-op" modes. List your high score on the Xbox Live� leaderboards and prove you're the best in the world!

x360-section-8-prejudice.exp: Four player survival mode called Swarm where players defend a terminal from enemies. Players can call in defensive structures and vehicles to aid.Also the multiplayer modes can be played against bots in comp stomp fashion.

x360-serious-sam-3-bfe.exp: Team up through the campaign friends for frantic, old school, shooting action.

x360-serious-sam-double-d-xxl.exp: Sweet and simple two player local co-op. All progress is saved only to the primary profile

x360-serious-sam-hd-the-first-encounter.exp: The Classic Serious Sam game is back with updated visuals for the Xbox 360. Team up in this no holds barred shooter.

x360-serious-sam-hd-the-second-encounter.exp: Co-Op is available through the game's story mode as well as in a brand new survival co-op mode.

x360-shank.exp: Shank has a 2 player co-op campaign with scenarios and bosses specifically designed for co-op.

x360-shank-2.exp: Two players can play locally or online in Shank 2's Survival Mode.

x360-shin-sangokumusou-4-special.exp: Co-Op Play is via Split Screen and allows you to team up with a buddy to conquer the endless hordes of baddies.

x360-shoot-many-robots.exp: Two to four players, either locally or online, can team up for run and gun fun against armies of deadly robots. Each player is awarded loot and nuts at the end of every level.

x360-shooting-love-200x.exp: Featured games include support for two-player simultaneous play. Select modes enable four-player co-op.

x360-shrek-forever-after.exp: Play with up to four people in drop-in/drop-out local co-op

x360-skate-3.exp: Players can Freeskate together, completing challenges, learning the courses, and creating customs parks.

x360-skylanders-giants.exp: Two local players can each use a different Skylander figure with a single Portal of Power to play through the main campaign.

x360-skylanders-imaginators.exp: Players can place two Creation Crystals or two toys or a combination of the Crystals and toys on the Portal of Power to maximize the fun!

x360-skylanders-spyro-s-adventure.exp: Play through the game's single player adventure with a friend. They can bring their own character(s) and jump in at any time.

x360-skylanders-superchargers.exp: Team up with a friend in local co-op or survival mode!

x360-skylanders-swap-force.exp: Team up with a friend in local co-op or survival mode for the third installment of the Skylanders series.

x360-skylanders-trap-team.exp: 2 player co-op is supported throughout the game in both story and Kaos Doom Challenge modes. Players can use their own characters and gold is shared.

x360-smash-tv.exp: Co-Op mode has both players teaming up to try to survive as well as competing for the most cash and prizes.

x360-sniper-elite-v2.exp: Two players can take on the entire campaign together online. Co-op mechanics include the ability to revive a fallen comrade or spot enemies with your binoculars, marking their locations for both players. Other co-op modes include Killy Tally (survive 10 waves of enemies), Bombing Run (hunt for vehicle parts before time runs out), and Overwatch (one player snipes while the other spots enemies and carries out objectives).

x360-snoopy-flying-ace.exp: Complete co-op challenges with a friend in this arcade flying game featuring Peanuts characters.

x360-sonic-free-riders.exp: Tag Race - Players start in splitscreen, but can join hands to fuse boards and power up which increases their speed. The challenge arises in learning how to turn and jump together. Relay Race - Which can be 2 player co-op or 2v2 competitive.

x360-sonic-s-ultimate-genesis-collection.exp: Some games offer drop-in and drop-out and most games offer play through the single player portion. Here is the complete list of co-op titles that are in compilation. Alien Syndrome Altered Beast Golden Axe I Golden Axe II Golden Axe III Sonic the Hedgehog 2 Sonic the Hedgehog 3 Streets of Rage Streets of Rage 2 Streets of Rage 3

x360-sonic-the-hedgehog-2-2.exp: With his new Super Spin Dash and "Tails" the Fox, Sonic is back and better than ever in Sonic The Hedgehog 2! Defy gravity in hair-raising loop-de-loops, bounce like a pinball and race like lightning. Play against friends at home or against others over Xbox LIVE in this classic game.

x360-sonic-the-hedgehog-4-episode-ii.exp: Two players can take on the entire campaign locally or online, selecting who will play as Sonic and Tails at the outset. Three different combo moves can be used at any time, allowing both players to work together to overcome obstacles. Players share rings and lives.

x360-south-park-let-s-go-tower-defense-p.exp: Team up in traditional tower defense gameplay. Players can work together to place defensive structures as well as throw snowballs at enemies.

x360-south-park-tenorman-s-revenge.exp: Play as one of South Park's favorite sons in four player local or online co-op.

x360-space-ark.exp: Fun arcade/puzzle game with a hint of retro arcade flavour; inspired by classic arcade games of the late 80s, such as Rainbow Island, Bubble Bobble and Arkanoid. Two players can work their way through the campaign offline together.

x360-space-channel-5-part-2.exp: Player 1 controls the directions while player 2 controls the chus and heys. If either player makes a mistake, and it's a heart loss for you.There is also a challenge mode where you have to build your rating up to 200%, without making a single mistake.

x360-space-invaders-extreme.exp: It's classic Space Invaders gameplay taken to the EXTREME. Join with up to 4 player as you take out waves upon waves of enemies as you try to get the highest score possible. Players share a single pool of lives.

x360-spare-parts.exp: Two players work together (locally or online) to find secret areas, be rewarded by co-op machines and utilise co-op moves to help you survive in the planet’s hostile environment.

x360-spec-ops-the-line.exp: A series of objective-based cooperative multiplayer scenarios set in Dubai after a series of cataclysmic sandstorms have wrecked the city. It includes four fast-paced missions, each with its own unique objectives, environments and playable characters.

x360-spelunky.exp: Four players can explore the world of Spelunky together in local co-op play.

x360-spider-man-friend-or-foe.exp: Drop in and play co-op allows friends to join in whenever they like and take over for your other character. Unlock battle arenas as you progress through the story to have massive one-on-one brawls with anyone on the roster!

x360-splosion-man.exp: Explode your way through the 50 co-op levels. Splosion man is a puzzle platformer with a unique twist, and co-op requires some quick thinking!

x360-star-trek.exp: Play through the entire campaign as Kirk and Spock in two player local or online co-op.

x360-star-trek-dac.exp: The game is a top down shooter featuring a co-op multiplayer mode. Any combination of human and AI players may be used up to 12 via LAN.

x360-star-trek-legacy.exp: Forget seeking out new life and exploring strange new worlds. Star Trek: Legacy is all about battles as you boldly blast your way through the entire Star Trek universe! Take command of Starfleet, concoct a battle strategy, and test your tactics in real-time combat set in dynamic, 3D space environments. Legacy draws from every Star Trek series, including Next Generation, Voyager, Deep Space Nine, Enterprise, and the original series. Fight Star Trek's most storied battles in single player. Lead Federation, Klingon, Borg, or Romulan fleets in massive multi-player campaigns. Victories bring Command Points, which you can use to customize your fleet and captains. Beam us up!

x360-star-wars-the-clone-wars-republic-h.exp: Star Wars: The Clone Wars -- Republic Heroes takes place between seasons 1 and 2 of the animated Clone Wars series and will feature a wide range of playable heroes, including Anakin Skywalker, Obi-Wan Kenobi, Mace Windu, Kit Fisto, and some of the clone trooper characters. You'll be able to play around with lots of force-enhanced powers and, best of all, work your way through the game cooperatively with a friend.

x360-steel-battalion-heavy-armor.exp: Four players stomp the battlegrounds together on a variety of maps, earning new unlockable items with which to customize their Vertical Tanks.

x360-streets-of-rage-2.exp: Players assume the role of one of three characters, each with their own strengths and weaknesses.

x360-super-contra.exp: Play co-op on the same console or on Xbox LIVE. Communicate with your buddy by voice using the Xbox 360 headset.

x360-switchball.exp: Team up with another friend through the game's co-op specific levels.

x360-takedown-red-sabre.exp: Team up with other players as a squad in five single missions or in terrorist hunt on the game's maps.

x360-tales-of-vesperia.exp: During the normal single player experience, you can use other controllers to control the other characters in the real time combat. Everything takes place on the same screen, but the camera zooms out so that all human-controlled characters can be seen.All you have to do is plug in additional controllers and set the control type for a given character to �semi-auto� or �manual�. Outside of combat, Player One controls the action. Thanks Razor Ace for the information

x360-teenage-mutant-ninja-turtles-turtle.exp: Players take control of one of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles in a journey through time with epic boss battles and more.

x360-tekken-6.exp: Players can team up online through the "Scenario Campaign" mode.

x360-tenchu-z.exp: Create your own fully customizable ninja with different skills, clothes, and other features and play with up to four people on-line or through system link to complete mission objectives

x360-terminator-salvation.exp: Terminator Salvation feature split screen co-op support through this third person action game. Background In Terminator: Salvation, you are John Connor, a soldier in this post-apocalyptic world, and it's up to you to lead your squad of loyal fighters in a desperate battle for survival against the superior forces of Skynet and its deadly Terminators. Use the environment and objects in it to provide cover and protection as the T-600 and T-7T shoot relentlessly at you and your squad from all angles and the lethal Aerostat blasts you from above.

x360-test-drive-unlimited-2.exp: There are two co-op modes to play - Keep the Distance You will have to stay within the distance of a couple of yards with car next to you, or if you’re the leader then the car behind you. Yes, it sounds dashing! The faster your team will go, the more points you earn. Follow the Leader In every race, the leader can see the next checkpoint. Once he has crossed that checkpoint the team members will be given a certain amount of time to cross that checkpoint. Difficulty of this mode depends on the leader of the pack.

x360-the-adventures-of-shuggy.exp: Play 36 twisted two-player levels in the offline co-op mode, with puzzles that can only be completed through cunning and teamwork.

x360-the-black-eyed-peas-experience.exp: Play with up to 2 dancers and 2 singers in the Black Eyed Peas Deluxe Mode.

x360-the-cave.exp: Two to three local co-op players work together to solve puzzles in this adventure platformer.

x360-the-chronicles-of-narnia-prince-cas.exp: Based on the movie of the same name, the game allows for two players to play through the single player story in Co-Op mode.

x360-the-crew.exp: Team up with friends or random players to complete missions and drive across a massive amount of realistic terrain.

x360-the-cursed-crusade.exp: A Middle Age bromance with two demon-cursed heroes, this Crusade really is Cursed.

x360-the-darkness-ii.exp: The Vendettas co-op mode is a separate story in which players can choose from four different characters and level them up in co-op play.

x360-the-dishwasher-dead-samurai.exp: The Dishwasher has arcade co-op, drop-in solo campaign co-op, and drop-in solo phantom guitar co-op using the guitar peripheral. Phantom guitar players can unload electric death by playing wicked solos, perform basic movement, and use the guitar's motion control to rip through enemies with a razor-sharp headstock.

x360-the-dishwasher-vampire-smile.exp: Hack and slash with friends as either Yuki or Dishwasher. Each character has their own unique weapons. Two additional players can join in as Dishwasher's Raven or Yuki's Cat for a more casual co-op experience.

x360-the-fancy-pants-adventures.exp: Work together to get through platforming levels as fast as possible, reach hard to get places with the help of your friend.
