x360-the-first-templar.exp: Players take control of either a French Templar, or his companion, a noble lady who has been proclaimed a heretic.Fast-paced cooperative play: players can assist one another as each takes on the role of the game's key characters. Drop-in/out cooperative gameplay lets the AI take over when one player leaves the game

x360-the-gunstringer.exp: One player controls the Gunstringer while the other can stand up and join in aas a second set of guns.

x360-the-legend-of-spyro-dawn-of-the-dra.exp: Players can drop-in/drop-out with the new cooperative feature. The co-op feature allows players to have the option of completing the game as either Spyro or Cynder, giving them more freedom to explore Spyro�s world in completely new ways. In the final chapter of the trilogy, players find Sypro teaming up with an unlikely ally - Cynder, his former enemy, to face his most challenging mission to date. As the Dark Master's (voiced by Mark Hamill) evil envelopes the world like a plague, Spyro must fulfill his destiny and unlock the true power of the purple dragon within him to stop the Dark Master in his tracks.

x360-the-lord-of-the-rings-war-in-the-no.exp: Play one of three unique classes in up to 3-player co-op in either split-screen, online, or mixed co-op. Battle through the campaign or a handful of challenge missions (horde-mode style) to level up and gain new skills.

x360-the-simpsons-arcade-game.exp: Up to four players can take on the roles of Homer, Marge, Bart, and Lisa in this beat-em-up. Team-up attacks allow multiple members of the family to do extra damage together.

x360-the-smurfs-2.exp: Four-Player Co-op: Play with four players on the screen simultaneously. Jump in and jump out seamlessly.

x360-the-undergarden.exp: Two players can team up locally to pollinate plants while listening to new age tunes.

x360-the-warriors-street-brawl.exp: Choose famous characters from the Warriors franchise and team up to take on bad guys in this beat em up.

x360-thunder-wolves.exp: Take control of a mercenary helicopter with local 2 player co-op. One player pilots while the other shoots as the gunner through the full Thunder Wolves campaign.

x360-time-pilot.exp: Fly into the past in Time Pilot! Control an experimental aircraft sent back in time to alter the path of the future. Travel to different periods both in the twentieth and twenty-first centuries, taking on enemy aircraft in daring aerial dogfights. Start by fighting biplanes in 1911 and end by combating swarms of UFOs! With enhanced graphics and an intense new soundtrack, Time Pilot is a new twist on an arcade classic. This enhanced version includes exciting new multiplayer modes.

x360-tiqal.exp: The Co-Op mode allows you to play through the adventure mode of the game with a friend. In TiQal, you have been chosen to make an epic journey through many obstacles to seek the help of the gods. The village of TiQal is in deep trouble! Destroy the block walls in your way by moving your magic Dropper left and right, rotating blocks, and dropping them into place to create squares of color. Build up multiple squares to score bonus points and unlock helpful power-ups. Do you have the skill and courage to complete your quest and save TiQal from certain destruction? [XBox.com]

x360-titanfall.exp: The Frontier Defense mode pits four players against increasingly difficult waves of AI attackers, it adds some all-new types of enemies to the action including Sniper and Suicide Specters, Arc Titans that can drop the shields of opponents who venture too close, and Mortar Titans that lob heavy shells from a distance. Defensive turrets can be placed around the battlefield, and new Loadout Crates will enable on-demand loadout switches during battle. Players who are killed in combat are returned to the field via a dropship that circles above the action before landing, allowing pilots to fire on their enemies through side windows before touchdown.

x360-tom-clancy-s-ghost-recon-future-sol.exp: Team up through a co-op campaign or play specific co-op modes. Local co-op play is limited to the Guerilla mode.

x360-tom-clancy-s-h-a-w-x.exp: Pick up a wingman - or pick up 3 as you dog fight it out with your buddies. Tom Clancy�s HAWX is the first air combat game set in the world-renowned Tom Clancy�s video game universe. Cutting-edge technology, devastating firepower, and intense dogfights bestow this new title a deserving place in the prestigious Tom Clancy franchise. Soon, flying at Mach 3 becomes a right, not a privilege.

x360-tom-clancy-s-rainbow-six-vegas-2.exp: The Co-Op mode allows you to play through the single player missions, but not in a story based setting. This removes cut scenes and voice overs, etc. The stakes are high when the world's most elite counter-terrorism unit enters Las Vegas, where over 36.7 million men, women and children visit each year. "Sin City," the home of the famous Las Vegas Strip, flashy hotels, high-rolling casinos and world-famous celebrities, becomes the setting for a terrorist threat of global proportions. What happens when one of the world's most famous cities is held hostage by terrorists?

x360-tom-clancy-s-splinter-cell-convicti.exp: Splinter Cell Conviction features a 6 hour co-op campaign that sets up the story of the single player campaign. Also included is "Deniable Ops," a four player online co-op mode with a few challenge modes. Hunter - wherein the objective is to clear the map of enemies. Infiltration - wherein you clear the map without being detected. Last Stand - the co-op survival mode wherein you protect an EMP from waves of enemies. Face Off - wherein players go head-to-head alongside teams of customizable AI characters.

x360-tom-clancy-s-splinter-cell-double-a.exp: Unlike the full story mode of the Xbox version, the 360 version's co-op is only a "sub mode" of the Spies vs Mercenaries mode in which you and two friends can take on AI Bots.

x360-too-human.exp: Play with up to 2 players online with drop-in/drop-out co-op support. The entire game was designed from the ground up for co-op including co-op specific character perks, item trading, character classes, and more. The game is an action RPG combining Norse mythology with cyberpunk tech. It's been touted as the evolution of Diablo. Be sure to read our Interview for more details!

x360-top-spin-3.exp: Take on the computer in doubles matches with your co-op partner or select mini games.

x360-tornado-outbreak.exp: Based on preliminary information, the co-op mode is separate from the main campaign.

x360-toy-soldiers-cold-war.exp: Join forces with your friends and play onthe couch or over Xbox LIVE in Campaign or Survival modes.

x360-toy-story-mania.exp: Four-player game support competitive and cooperative multiplayer options.

x360-transformers-fall-of-cybertron.exp: Until the servers were shut down, four players could team up for the online Escalation mode.

x360-transformers-rise-of-the-dark-spark.exp: Until the servers where shut down, Players could play together in Escalation, which delivers wave-based, survival-style gameplay for up to four players online cooperatively. It features new, upgradeable defense systems, recognizable adversaries from the lore, and an expanded roster of playable characters from past and present.

x360-trine-2.exp: A side-scrolling puzzle-platforming game featuring up to three players working together to complete the campaign.

x360-tron.exp: The arcade classic is back! And Tron is even better this time around with enhanced graphics, CD-quality sound and two-person multiplayer. Battle as mighty video warrior Tron against the insidious Master Control Program and his ruthless right-hand man, Sark. Tron offers a retro-futuristic test of gaming ability. Race life cycles, demolish tanks, dodge grid bugs, and even face off against the MCP himself to find out who truly rules the computer world! [Xbox.com]

x360-trouble-witches-neo.exp: Team up with a friend in the side scrolling shooter.

x360-turok.exp: Co-Op in this game is 3 pre-set scenarios where up to 4 people can team up to complete an objective. The scenarios have their own story, and each one takes about 20 minutes to complete. You are Turok�, a member of the special forces squad Whiskey Company, in this epic first-person shooter set on a dark, mysterious planet in the future. Use your elite military training to elude an army of soldiers, the ravenous, unpredictable dinosaurs, and other massive creatures that populate this dangerous environment. Good luck, soldier! [Xbox.com]

x360-two-worlds.exp: The world will change with your choices, and your choices will change the world! A true role-playing experience is in your hands as you enter a dynamic and completely non-linear storyline. Use an intuitive yet complex combat system for beautifully-choreographed fights. Lots of traps and snares are available to challenge your enemies. Choose a class for your character including Dwarves, Orcs, Elves, and Reptiles, and explore different careers to fit your desired goals. Find a huge variety of items and weapons, all generated so they're never in the same place twice as you travel terrains ranging from snow-capped mountains to deep caves.

x360-ugly-americans-apocalypsegeddon.exp: Four players can co-op online, locally, or any combination of online and local play.

x360-undertow.exp: Undertow is a fast-paced action-shooter that sends you underwater as you battle up to 16 players for control of the oceans! Non-stop conquest-style battles push the envelope of onscreen effects and combat action and boast some of the most stunning graphics ever seen in an Xbox LIVE� Arcade title. Undertow features 16-player multiplayer battles and two-player co-op modes.

x360-uno-rush.exp: Play 2-player Team Rush against the computer or real players.

x360-up.exp: Play as Carl or Russel with a friend as you play through the game. Certain puzzles require both players to work together.

x360-voltron-defender-of-the-universe.exp: Team up with up to five players for true Voltron action!

x360-warface.exp: Play through co-op specific scenarios with your friends.

x360-warhammer-40-000-kill-team.exp: Team up against enemies with a friend. Choose from 4 classes: Sternguard Veteran ,Techmarine, Vanguard Veteran and Librarian

x360-warhammer-40-000-space-marine.exp: The online only survival mode is called Exterminatus, putting a squad of four Space Marines against Orks and other baddies in a violent score based fight to the death. There are three classes to choose from: the Tactical Marine, Devastator or Assault Marine and players will be able to utilize weapons and perks available to those classes from both co-op and multiplayer versus modes.

x360-warriors-orochi.exp: Activating the 2-player-mode on the Pre-Battle-Screen allows for a second player to enter the battle on your side.

x360-world-gone-sour.exp: Two players can play the entire adventure together locally- sharing mini Sour Patch Kid followers, solving puzzles, and teaming up to take down enemies. An "MVP" is awarded at the end of each level for collecting the most points for the team.

x360-worms-revolution.exp: Team up against the AI in the game's skirmish mode.

x360-wwe-12.exp: Play 2 vs AI in Tag Team, Triple Threat and variations of these. Plays 3 vs AI in 6-Man matches and variations of it.

x360-wwe-13.exp: Two players can wrassle or sportingly entertain the masses in local tag matches.

x360-x-men.exp: The players choose one of six X-Men: Cyclops, Colossus, Wolverine, Storm, Nightcrawler, or Dazzler.

x360-yie-ar-kung-fu.exp: Oolong has spent his entire life training for the Martial Arts Championship. The Championship has attracted masters of different disciplines, all fighting to be named champion. In Yie Ar Kung-Fu�, Oolong must use his own fighting moves and face masters of the throwing shuriken, nunchaku, bo, chain, and more to fulfill his destiny. With enhanced graphics, hand-painted backgrounds, and new achievements, this classic fighting game is sure to test your skills. Will you fight like a tiger or run away in shame?

x360-young-justice-legacy.exp: Play as your favorite character from the Young Justice: Legacy with up to two of your friends as you battle some of their greatest foes

x360-zeno-clash-ii.exp: Play through the game's single player experience in co-op in this first person brawler. Ghat can now be joined by his sister Rimat.

x360-zeno-clash-ultimate-edition.exp: Players will be able to team up to take on enemies in a series of challenges in the Tower Challenge mode.

x360-zombie-apocalypse.exp: Four players can kill the zombie horde either locally or online in this Left 4 Dead meets Arcade game.

x360-zombie-apocalypse-never-die-alone.exp: Up to four players can play shared screen or online (or combination) co-op a series of loosely connected maps.

x360-zombie-wranglers.exp: This top down/3rd person shoot has a unique twist to your traditional zombie game. You'll be sucking up various type of zombies instead of exploding them. All while working with 3 of your buddies. Challenges are completed cooperatively.

xblig-a-game-you-can-t-beat.exp: Two player can try to get the ball to the end together.

xblig-a-game-you-can-t-beat-2.exp: Two player can try to get the ball to the end together.

xblig-a-robots-conundrum.exp: Play through the campaign with a friend. Earn credits and see how well you work as a team.

xblig-a-shooter.exp: With carefully crafted gameplay to handle 2,3 or 4 player cooperative modes, you know you can have a blast with friends and family. And those friends can help you proceed further in the game.

xblig-a-wizard-s-odyssey.exp: Team up with friends (via XBOX Live, system link, or a different controller on the same XBOX 360).

xblig-aardvark.exp: Two players with two paddles equals faster level clearing.

xblig-abaddon.exp: Supports 4-player networked co-op, and 2-player local co-op.

xblig-abaddon-retribution.exp: Supports 4-player networked co-op, and 2-player local co-op.

xblig-aceball.exp: Two players can play the arcade mode together.

xblig-acid-rain-heroes.exp: The game features a local split-screen mode allowing for two people to save the survivors together.

xblig-adrenaline.exp: Traverse the ethereal solo, or neck-and-neck with 3 of your friends!

xblig-adrift.exp: Invite your friends to join you in co-op story play or fun packed party mode.

xblig-air-legends.exp: The game offers co-operative game modes for two players.

xblig-akujin.exp: Two players are able to fly together and destroy all the enemies.

xblig-alien-jelly.exp: Work together to solve any level with up to four player local co-op.

xblig-almost-total-mayhem.exp: Two players can team up against the AI.

xblig-amniotic.exp: Two cells can fight side by side in order to survive the onslaught.

xblig-angle-of-attack.exp: Up to four players can help each other collecting nodes.

xblig-beat-hazard.exp: Team up with a friend and groove out/shoot down foes to your favorite tracks

xblig-bleed.exp: 2-player local co-op for all modes (Story, Arcade, and Challenge). Requires at least one gamepad

xblig-castleminer-z.exp: Play online with up to 7 friends in CastleMiner Z's infinite world in a variety of modes. Go for endurance, survival, or creative mode as you build structures, craft weapons, and explore the world.

xblig-chasing-styx.exp: Two player local co-op is supported so bring a friend to help conquer the fast-paced action and frenetic boss battles.

xblig-crawlers-and-brawlers.exp: Play with up to 4 friends without a story but exploring all 11 procedurally generated dungeons from the single player mode..

xblig-creed-arena.exp: The game allows two players to play through co-op tournaments either in local split-screen or online.

xblig-dual-zone.exp: Each of the space ships is controlled by a player.

xblig-endless-swarm.exp: A second player can join in at any time and help keep the enemies at bay.

xblig-explosionade.exp: Grab a buddy for some two player local co-op. Drop-in and drop-out of explosive action in this short, but polished indie game

xblig-flotilla.exp: Each player controls one or more ships as they do battle against sometimes seemingly impossible odds

xblig-gamerbotsthird-robot-shooting.exp: Up to three players can shoot their way through the campaign both via system link as well as online.

xblig-jimmy-vs-zombies.exp: Team up with a local co-op partner to fight off the hordes of undead, save your granny, and reclaim Jimmy's guitar

xblig-murky-horizon.exp: 4 players team up to drop walls and defense towers in the path of lizardlike invaders, while shooting them at the same time!

xblig-octagon.exp: Use the color attraction mechanic to pull enemies away from a buddy in need, and keep an eye on your energy gauge to make sure you don't spoil it for you both

xblig-plague.exp: Team up with up to three friends locally to run, gun, and jump in order to save games from being wiped out by a malicious virus

xblig-rise-of-the-ravager.exp: Invite up to 3 friends to blast hordes of enemies utilizing a unique combat system based on color.

xblig-shoot-1up.exp: 2 PLAYER CO-OP play for 60 SIMULTANEOUS player ship INSANITY!

xblig-survivalist.exp: Once your community is big enough up to three friends can join in and help out.

xblig-tank-battles.exp: Team Deathmatch and Capture the Flag can be played as a human team against bots.

xblig-the-co-op-zombie-game.exp: Up to four people can kill their way through the zombie hordes.

xblig-the-co-op-zombie-game-2.exp: Up to four people can kill their way through the zombie hordes.

xblig-the-great-paper-adventure.exp: A second player can drop in at any time with their own ship and help fight the enemies.

xblig-the-hearts-of-men-throne-of-deceit.exp: Up to four players can play through the story together or try to survive in the horde mode "Misery's Playhouse".

xblig-zombie-defense-squad.exp: Up to four people can kill their way through the zombie hordes.

xbox-187-ride-or-die.exp: Get together in the car with a friend - one drives, the other shoots -, and play either Whip Races ("normal" races), Deathmatch or Minefield (races with mines instead of power-ups) against the AI. You have to unlock the stages in Story mode first however which can also be done with a friend.

xbox-alien-hominid.exp: Play through the game's story mode with a friend, or play co-op mini games with four people.

xbox-baldur-s-gate-dark-alliance.exp: Two players could work together, sharing the same screen and making sure to cover each other's back. As is always the case, the fun factor multiplies greatly when you've got a buddy along for the ride. Deciding on the best strategies to defeat the bosses and dividing up the loot drops for maximum effectiveness were just two ways that cooperation and teamwork made the entire heroic experience that much smoother and more enjoyable.

xbox-baldur-s-gate-dark-alliance-ii.exp: Two players could work together, sharing the same screen and making sure to cover each other's back.

xbox-batman-rise-of-sin-tzu.exp: The single-player story mode can be played in co-op with 2 players. Additionally, there is a challenge mode that can also be played co-op (also has a competitive option).

xbox-battle-engine-aquila.exp: While you can't play the campaign together once you've unlocked the missions you can go through them with a second player in local split-screen coop.

xbox-blazing-angels-squadrons-of-wwii.exp: All multiplayer modes can be played against the AI. In addition there are historical missions available to tackle with friends.

xbox-brothers-in-arms-earned-in-blood.exp: Take on the enemy with a friend by your side. Work together and utilize each other's squads or face certain death.

xbox-close-combat-first-to-fight.exp: Team up with friends in this tactical military game. Local and online play is supported.

xbox-combat-elite-wwii-paratroopers.exp: The screen is centered between both characters and they need to stay on the same screen while shooting all those pesky Nazis.

xbox-conflict-global-terror.exp: Share weapons and ammo, as you team up through the game's missions in this tactical shooter.

xbox-delta-force-black-hawk-down.exp: Complete unique missions and goals with a team of friends.

xbox-destroy-all-humans-2.exp: The new co-op multiplayer mode gives you the option to play story mode or several minigames such as Tennis and Duel together with a friend.

xbox-digimon-world-4.exp: Up to four players can team up and play through the game together. Each player creates/calls their own Digimon they then take control over.

xbox-dragon-ball-z-sagas.exp: The co-op mode allows two players to play through the chapters of the single player game together. To account for the second player, the difficulty level is increased.

xbox-dungeons-and-dragons-heroes.exp: Bring your character into the game with four different roles (Fighter,Wizard, Cleric or Thief) and hack and slash your way through the game's story.

xbox-dynasty-warriors-3.exp: For the first time in the series battle through the missions side-by-side in local splitscreen-mode.

xbox-dynasty-warriors-4.exp: Battle through the missions side-by-side in local splitscreen-mode.

xbox-dynasty-warriors-5.exp: Battle through the missions side-by-side in local splitscreen-mode.

xbox-eragon.exp: Combine forces with Brom or Murtagh at any point in two-player drop-in/drop out, co-op mode.

xbox-espn-mls-extratime-2002.exp: Up to four players can take on a team of CPU players. Each human takes control of a player on the field and can switch freely between each available player as long it is not controlled by another human.

xbox-espn-nba-2night-2002.exp: Up to four players can play on the same team against a computer-controlled opponent. Jumping in and out is possible at any time.

xbox-fantastic-four.exp: Players can choose a member of the Fantastic Four to work together though the game's missions.

xbox-final-fight-streetwise.exp: Play as one of four characters with your friend in this traditional beat em up.

xbox-full-spectrum-warrior.exp: Play cooperatively through the single player game as each player controls a fire team

xbox-full-spectrum-warrior-ten-hammers.exp: Play coop missions in which each player controls a fire team.

xbox-gauntlet-dark-legacy.exp: With up to 3 of your friends, embark on a quest to collect the mythic 13 rune stones and battle the evil wizard Garm.

xbox-gladius.exp: Glaidus' Co-op mode enables up to four players to participate in the Story mode and play through the game fighting side-by-side. Player one is the main person in charge of initializing all the movement made by the school, including navigating the World Map and manipulating the menu screens. Once player one has initiated a battle in one of the arenas or the school is attacked during a random encounter, the other players may then join choosing one of the available gladiators.

xbox-grand-theft-auto-san-andreas.exp: GTA features set co-op scenarios in a free roam mode as well as a cooperative "rampage" gameplay mode.

xbox-greg-hastings-tournament-paintball-.exp: While playing in career mode, you can invite up to 3 of your friends or family to join your team and help your career along. In the Team Manager screen, "check in" additional players. As a co-op player, you inherit all of your teammate's gear and attributes.

xbox-guilty-gear-isuka.exp: Guilty Gear Isuka goes from fighter to brawler when you dive into GG Boost Mode . Punch/kick/cut/grapple your way through waves of formidable opponents, and feel free to invite a friend to help; four-player co-op (both local and when Xbox Live was still around also online) can give you that extra edge you need.

xbox-halo-combat-evolved.exp: The game that started it all for the Xbox featured a 2 player co-op mode through the entire game's story.

xbox-harry-potter-and-the-goblet-of-fire.exp: Players team up as Harry, Ron, and Hermione. Teamwork spells are particularly fun.

xbox-hunter-the-reckoning-redeemer.exp: Choose one of five different monster hunter characters with their own strengths and abilities as you team up with your partner.

xbox-judge-dredd-dredd-vs-death.exp: Play through the campaign via splitscreen with a friend in splitscreen.

xbox-justice-league-heroes.exp: Justice League Heroes is role-playing action starring the world's greatest heroes! For the first time, 1 or 2 players can play as Batman, Superman, Wonder Woman, The Flash, Green Lantern, Martian Manhunter, Zatanna and others -- The Justice League. They'll face a legion of notorious villains, as Brainiac and his cronies try to conquer the world and eliminate the Justice League forever. Using the extraordinary superpowers and amazing skills of Batman, Superman, Green Lantern, The Flash, Wonder Woman, and other favorite DC Comics super heroes, players must join the Justice League to ultimately save humanity from Brainiac and the dark forces that lurk in the universe.

xbox-lego-star-wars-ii-the-original-tril.exp: A second player can jump in at any time and take control of the second character.

xbox-lego-star-wars-the-video-game.exp: A second player can jump in at any time and take control of the second character.

xbox-medal-of-honor-rising-sun.exp: This WWII FPS takes place in the Pacific. Play through the campaign with a friend in splitscreen.

xbox-men-of-valor.exp: Play through the entire game in split screen co-op.

xbox-metal-slug-3.exp: Team up with another player to play through the entire campaign.

xbox-metal-slug-4.exp: Two player can join up and fight their way through the campaign.

xbox-metal-slug-5.exp: A second player can join the fight at any time.

xbox-mortal-kombat-shaolin-monks.exp: Play as Liu Kang or Kung Lao, each with their own unique repertoire of four Attack Styles plus Special Attacks, and Fatalities

xbox-namco-museum.exp: Players can team up on the couch in those titles that support it.

xbox-obscure.exp: Survive with a friend as one of five characters.

xbox-psyvariar-2.exp: A second ship can join in at any time and help fight the enemies.

xbox-samurai-warriors.exp: Team up with a friend in co-op play and take on the hordes together.

xbox-serious-sam.exp: Take on the endless hordes of zany enemies with your friends.

xbox-serious-sam-2.exp: Team up with friends in this over the top action game.

xbox-shadow-ops-red-mercury.exp: Play through ten co-op levels in two player splitscreen.

xbox-shrek-2.exp: Four players choose from ten characters in an action adventure game based on the movie of the same name.

xbox-spikeout-battle-street.exp: Up to four players can team, each choosing one of the available characters, and play through the game together. The game offers local co-op with a split screen, system link connections and until the Xbox Live service was shut down even online co-op was available.

xbox-star-wars-jedi-starfighter.exp: Sequel to Starfighter, allows for split screen. At times you are in individual ships, other times the second player is turret based in your fighter.

xbox-star-wars-the-clone-wars.exp: Both variants (ground and vehicle) of the game mode Jedi Academy can be played with four players. Its a wave-based mode in which you team up and survive as long as possible. There are so-called gladiator/elimination rounds where everyone has to fight everyone and at the end of a session the player with the highest score is crowned the winner, but the main part of the game mode is co-op focused.

xbox-stubbs-the-zombie-in-rebel-without-.exp: Play through the single player game as a pair of Stubbs!

xbox-taito-legends.exp: A few of the games allow a second player to enter and play through the campaign/the levels together.

xbox-taito-legends-2.exp: A few of the games allowother players to enter and play through the campaign/the levels together.

xbox-teen-titans.exp: Up to four players choose from the available roster of characters and play through the story mode together.

xbox-teenage-mutant-ninja-turtles-3-muta.exp: All four turtles can be controlled by a player both in the main game and Turtles in Time.

xbox-tenchu-return-from-darkness.exp: Play through special co-op missions together with a friend. This was also possible online via Xbox Live until the servers were shut down.

xbox-terminator-3-the-redemption.exp: Team up against waves of enemies in TechCom Force co-op mode.

xbox-the-chronicles-of-narnia-the-lion-t.exp: Get your friend to join the game at any time and play in co-op mode.

xbox-the-incredibles-rise-of-the-undermi.exp: Two players take control of Mr. Incredible and Frozone and fight together to destroy the Underminer and his evil robots.

xbox-the-lord-of-the-rings-the-return-of.exp: The co-op for this game runs the same as singleplayer, though you are forced to play the levels in a specific order and both players have to stay on a single screen. This makes the second half of the first level, the Path of the Dead, very difficult because you have to escape from a collapsing dungeon.The genre is more of a hack and slash.

xbox-the-lord-of-the-rings-the-third-age.exp: In co-op mode a second player takes control of half of the available characters during combat.

xbox-the-sims-2.exp: Controlling two different Sims, two players can play the game together in a vertical split-screen mode.

xbox-the-warriors.exp: Team up in this gang themed brawler with a friend at anytime.

xbox-timesplitters-2.exp: Timesplitters 2 is an FPS whose co-op mode is the same as its single-player mode, except with up 2 players with lowered health.

xbox-timesplitters-future-perfect.exp: Co-Op is available in a variety of modes and gameplay.

xbox-tom-clancy-s-ghost-recon.exp: The game offers three co-op modes: Firefight (randomly placed enemies that have to be defeated), Mission (the single player campaign missions) and Recon (get from the insertion zone to the extraction zone). Two players can play in split-screen. Graphics are diminished and some objects removed to handle the extra rendering. Using system link up to 6 players can play together.

xbox-tom-clancy-s-ghost-recon-2-summit-s.exp: Four players can play the campaign or one of the several co-op modes. Co-op can be played in splitscreen, online, or both.

xbox-tom-clancy-s-ghost-recon-advanced-w.exp: Two players can tackle the campaign either splitscreen or online.

xbox-tom-clancy-s-rainbow-six-3.exp: Strategize with 3 friends in co-op missions via system link.

xbox-tom-clancy-s-rainbow-six-3-black-ar.exp: The game offers two cooperative game modes: Practice Mission (play the single-player missions with friends) and Terrorist Hunt (hunt down terrorists). Both modes can be played with a friend in local splitscreen or up to four players via system link. Xbox Live was also available but that service has been shut down.

xbox-tom-clancy-s-rainbow-six-critical-h.exp: The game modes Practice Mission (play through the single player missions) and Terrorist Hunt (kill all terrorists) are available for two players in split-screen mode.

xbox-tom-clancy-s-rainbow-six-lockdown.exp: Practice Mission (the single-player missions) as well as Terrorist Hunt (Hunt all terrorists in a level) are available for two players in split-screen or up to four using system link. Xbox Live was also available but the service has been shut down.

xbox-tom-clancy-s-splinter-cell-double-a.exp: The Xbox version is BackCompat and features the return of the two agent co-op, which the Xbox 360 version lacks.

xbox-unreal-championship.exp: Take on a team of bots with friends both in the available team-modes in local splitscreen or using system link.

xbox-unreal-championship-2-the-liandri-c.exp: Take on bots with friends in the team-based modes both in local splitscreen, using system link or over Xbox Live.

xbox-xiaolin-showdown.exp: You can play all game modes with up to three friends. If no human is available, the will AI will take over. Each takes control of one of the available characters. However only one character at a time can equip the same Shen Gong Wu (basically power-ups for your character).
